Name: Pet and Animal Friendship Tweaks
Author: Kowserkhan
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod allows you to configure the heart limits of your pets and farm animals. Pet and farm animal friendship logic works differently,[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]each heart is 200 points with a max of 1000 (5 hearts). This mod allows it to go to upto a max of 3000 (15 hearts). Took me putting 19 hours into finding the actual code and using ai to make the edits I needed. if any bugs come uo do let me know. Updates may be slow as my classes are starting again.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Download the main file and extract to your Mods folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] is required[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional but will be easier to configure than editing config file.[/color][/size]


[size=4][b]Codes[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://github.com/Kowserkhan/PetAnimalFriendshipTweaks]Source code Github[/url][/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: Pet and Animal Friendship Tweaks
Manifest.Description: Raises the friendship point cap for pets and farm animals beyond vanilla's 5-heart (1000 point) limit.
Manifest.Author: Kowserkhan
